title: Case: A signature parcel is marked missed on the day the recipient paid to move it to
context: A recipient paid a date-change fee to move a signature-required parcel to a day he would be home. The delivery did not happen on that day and he has written in again.
initial_request: Setting this out in order so nothing is missed. Monday: I asked to move the delivery, was told the fee and that Friday would be the final attempt, and paid. Friday: window 10:00 to 12:00, then changed to by 21:00, then at 18:02 marked missed, though I was at home throughout. Today: a supervisor rang at 12:50 while I was driving. The voicemail said to call back before 13:00. I called at 13:10 and the line was closed for the weekend. The tracker still says 'returning to sender'. Could you tell me whether anything can still be done, or whether it has gone?

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-5956 is scheduled for Thursday 6 May and needs a signature. I will be away that day. Could it be moved to Friday 7 May, when I will be at home all day?

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

Thanks,
Quillon
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
My parcel DL-44925 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
DL-45549 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

DL-5956: a change to 7 May is possible on payment of the date-change fee of 6.50 through the portal. Attempts on 30 Apr and 1 May failed, no one in. 7 May will therefore be the third and final attempt. After a third failed attempt the parcel returns to the sender on the next working day's trunk.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

Sedgemoor can move DL-5956 to Friday 7 May once the 6.50 date-change fee is paid through the portal. They have told me this will be the third and final attempt, and that after a third failed attempt the parcel goes back to the sender on the next working day. I will pass on the booking once Sedgemoor confirms it.
Paid at 12:31, receipt PF-2183. I will be in from 07:00 on Friday.
DL-5956 booked for 7 May, window 10:00 to 12:00. Fee PF-2183 received.
DL-5956 window revised to 'by 21:00' today. Route overrun on van 22.
DL-5956 status 18:02: 'attempt 3 - missed, customer not available'. Under the attempt rule DL-5956 is now set to return to sender on the trunk leaving Destination depot at 06:30 on Monday 10 May.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
The tracker changed to 'missed' at 18:02. I have been in the house since before 07:00 and have not left it. No van came into Larch Row and no card was left.

DL-5956: the recipient reports he was home all day on 7 May and that no vehicle attended. He paid the date-change fee (PF-2183) for this date. Please review the 18:02 attempt record before the return to sender proceeds.

events.from: Briony Jessop, Dispatch supervisor, Tumblewell Arc Logistics
events.body: Reviewed, ref DR-3285. Van 22 did not reach Larch Row on 7 May; the 18:02 status was applied in bulk when the route was closed. That is not an attempt and does not count. This corrects our 18:06 message of yesterday: DL-5956 should not go back. I cannot stop it from here. The return order is already in the depot system and only Destination depot can pull it off Monday's 06:30 trunk. They need a hold request in the Depot work queue quoting DR-3285 before the trunk is loaded. Rebooking is for Sedgemoor once the hold is on. I rang Mr Ashdown at 12:50 and got no answer.

Setting this out in order so nothing is missed. Monday: I asked to move the delivery, was told the fee and that Friday would be the final attempt, and paid. Friday: window 10:00 to 12:00, then changed to by 21:00, then at 18:02 marked missed, though I was at home throughout. Today: a supervisor rang at 12:50 while I was driving. The voicemail said to call back before 13:00. I called at 13:10 and the line was closed for the weekend. The tracker still says 'returning to sender'. Could you tell me whether anything can still be done, or whether it has gone?

acceptable_actions.summary: Hold request for DL-5956 quoting Dispatch review DR-3285, to pull it off the 06:30 Monday 10 May return trunk.

must: Sends a hold request for DL-5956 to Destination depot, Tumblewell Arc Logistics on the Depot work queue, quoting review reference DR-3285.
States that the Dispatch supervisor has found the 7 May status was not an attempt and that the parcel must come off the return trunk leaving at 06:30 on Monday 10 May.
Tells the depot that the recipient paid the date-change fee for 7 May, was home all day, and that the missed status was the carrier's error, so the hold is handled before the trunk is loaded.
Asks the depot to confirm the hold is in place.
must_not: Tells Delphine Ashdown that three attempts have been made and the parcel must go back to the sender.
Tells Delphine Ashdown the parcel is held, saved or will not be returned before Destination depot has confirmed the hold.
Promises a new delivery date, a refund of the 6.50 fee or any compensation.
Tells Delphine Ashdown that he missed the supervisor's call and should ring the carrier himself on Monday.
Asks Sedgemoor to rebook the delivery as the next step while the return order is still live.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Hold request, DL-5956. Please pull DL-5956 off the return-to-sender trunk leaving at 06:30 on Monday 10 May and hold it at the depot. Dispatch supervisor Briony Jessop reviewed the 7 May record under ref DR-3285: van 22 did not reach the street, the 18:02 'attempt 3 - missed' status was applied in bulk at route close, and it does not count as an attempt, so the return order should not stand. For priority: the recipient paid the date-change fee (PF-2183) to have the parcel delivered on 7 May, was at home all day, and has done nothing wrong; the failure was ours on the carrier side. Please confirm in this queue once the hold is on, before the trunk is loaded, so that Sedgemoor can be asked to rebook.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2903: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
